title: doctor's switch row names a Homebrew keg by its Cellar path, which the next brew upgrade removes, where every other reader names the opt link
body:
After `devbin use` points the switch at Homebrew's keg, doctor's switch row prints `ok switch: the link names <prefix>/Cellar/devbin/<version>/libexec`: machine_link_state (lib/helpers, from :3839 on main at 1b4812f7; about :4335-4339 in dc's stage 7 build) names the keg by its physical path. Every other reader names a keg by its opt link, through install_named_root (lib/helpers:3655), and a Cellar path names a version the next `brew upgrade devbin` removes, so the line a user copies from doctor goes stale. use.bats' fixture hid it, since it built a real opt directory rather than Homebrew's opt link. Measured by the critic-shell review of 0270 (2026-10-28) at dc's stage 7 build. Filed by vc; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Fix

machine_link_state names a keg through install_named_root, as every other reader does.

## Done when

1. With the switch pointed at a keg reached through Homebrew's opt link, doctor's switch row and a bare `devbin use` name the opt path, and no line names `Cellar/devbin`. The use.bats arm asserts both, red on main.
2. use.bats and doctor.bats pass under BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

- machine_link_state names a Homebrew keg by its opt link, through install_named_root, as every other reader does, so doctor's switch row no longer names a Cellar path the next brew upgrade removes.
- Landed on main: `0017e2b2`.
- Arm: use.bats, with the link into the keg through Homebrew's opt link: doctor's switch row names the opt path, a bare use reports the link, and neither prints Cellar/devbin.
- Desk evidence: hv's full run 20261029-1314, 2826 counted, ran every arm above ok.
- Run 20261029-1336 (`--failed`) ran that run's two reds, neither in this issue's arms, ok at their fixes, 2 of 2, so main at 5085ae24 is green.
